name: Fieldset
description: Groups related fields under a legend (title and description), as a panel, a divided section or plain.

props.name: variant
props.description: A bordered panel, a section with an edge under it, or no chrome. Emitted as data-variant.

props.name: title
props.description: The group's name, in the legend. Announced with each field inside.

props.name: description
props.description: Supporting text in the legend, under the title.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables every control inside (native fieldset disabled). Emitted as data-disabled.

props.name: classes
props.description: Extra classes per part, such as { legend: '…', title: '…' }.

parts.name: root
parts.description: The native fieldset; the default slot holds the fields.

parts.name: legend
parts.description: The native legend, holding the title and description.

requirements: A native fieldset and legend, so the group's name is announced with each field inside.
Disabled uses the native disabled attribute, which disables every control inside.
Don't nest fieldsets more than one level.
Fields side by side go in a row: <div data-scope="fieldset" data-part="row">, a grid that wraps on narrow screens.

fixture.content: Full name, email and phone fields go here.

parts.description: Who buyers and renters should reach.
